Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 31 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market.

Responsibilites :

• Submit the investigation report progress stepwise and timely, to ensure that all working activities are carried out safely by complying with all procedures, Law or Others Regulations applicable requirements related to occupational safety.
• Coordinate with SHE Operation Department in maintaining ISO 45001 compliance in SHE Division.
• Coordinate with CSP2 section, CSP3 section and SHE Operation Department in conducting SHE Culture/Promotion Program.
• Involved in incident investigation meeting as facilitator; provide the incident investigation report and Lesson Learn report; monitor the follow up of corrective action report and preventive action report.
• Involved in PSM audit, HIRADC audit; provide its finding report; and monitor the follow up of corrective action report and preventive action report.
• Assist internal audit with the auditor of the company such as: Quality Assurance Section, or from outside companies such as: insurance, certification bodies, government, etc.
• Coordinate with HR for worker training in areas such as required by SHE laws and regulations.

Qualifications :

• Minimum Bachelor Degree in major Chemical Engineering.
• Minimum 5 years experience in handling compliance and incident investigation or related field.
• Strong understanding of process manufacturing equipment, device and analysis for problem solving.
• Experience with continous improvement intended to assure that effective program are in place for identifying, eliminating, or controlling hazards that could adversely impact a company's physical and human assets.
• Hold certification SMK3 Auditor, ISO 45001, Accident/Incident Investigation from IOSH and General OSH expert from Kemnaker.
• Fluent in English both spoken & written.

This position will be placed in site office Cilegon.

Important Notes :
